# VyaparSethu

> India's verified B2B trade network for MSMEs. Connects
> buyers and suppliers with GST-verified profiles, protected
> payments, and 24-hour quotations. Focused on Steel, Metals,
> Chemicals, and Industrial supply chains across Maharashtra.
